coverage.origin_classification: Frontend: accepted application source. CRT: runtime.c overrides, explicit CRT variants elsewhere in source, and matched LIBC.LIB/SETARGV code. Imports: import thunks. Includes shared text data; categories are disjoint. This describes accepted reconstruction origins, not a complete original linker map.
coverage.metric: Union of accepted original code extents, shared text data, CRT and import thunks, clipped to code-section VirtualSize; not branch coverage.

shared_source_policy: Published C/H held stable through final checks; exact before/after hashes retained in final-checks/legacy-stable-validation.json.
scope: Valid named-base records/counted strings/code callbacks plus explicit invalid relative-scalar diagnostic recovery. No claim unsupported segment syntax is valid; no public producer for dormant segment handlers, no target-global/token seeding.
